# Output and exit codes

Default output is human text. `--json` prints exactly one line:

```
{"schema":"orca-cli-response-v1","status":<http status, 0 when refused here>,"commandId":"<id, a write>","body":<answer>,"request":<only when the outcome is uncertain>}
```

When `request` is present the outcome is uncertain (timeout, dropped connection, `retryable: true`): `orca command retry --request <file|->` looks the id up and resends exactly those bytes. Never re-run the command with a new id.

| exit | meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | the panel answered 2xx (or a local command succeeded) |
| 1 | refused here, before anything was sent |
| 2 | the panel answered an error; `body.error.code` names it (see error-codes.md) |
| 3 | the CLI crashed |

## Commands with their own exit codes

- `orca status`: 0 every check ok (warnings allowed); 1 a check failed
- `orca doctor`: 0 every check ok (warnings allowed); 1 a check failed
- `orca decision validate`: 0 every line valid; 1 a line rejected, or nothing found to validate; 2 downgraded (nothing rejected)
- `orca decision metrics`: 0 reported; 1 refused by name; 6 reported in full, and some lines were malformed
- `orca decision compact-reviews`: 0 reported (and applied); 1 refused by name
- `orca plan preview`: 0 the plan is legal; 1 rejected (the report says why)
- `orca agent init`: 0 done; 1 refused by name
- `orca agent show`: 0 done; 1 refused by name
- `orca agent refresh`: 0 done; 1 refused by name
- `orca dev gate`: 0 allowed; 1 refused here (bad arguments); 2 block
- `orca dev level`: 0 answered (a missing reading is answered too); 1 refused here (bad arguments)
- `orca dev checkpoint write`: 0 written and committed; 1 refused by name
- `orca dev resume`: 0 every measurement as recorded; 1 refused by name; 2 a re-run measurement changed its exit code
- `orca dev chain start`: 0 done; 1 refused before anything was written; 2 an anomaly; 3 blocked on a person; 4 a limit was reached
- `orca dev chain stop`: 0 done; 1 refused by name; 2 an anomaly
- `orca dev chain unlock`: 0 done; 1 refused by name; 2 an anomaly
- `orca dev check-append-only`: 0 append-only; 1 the diff deletes a line
- `orca dev correct`: 0 recorded (and closed); 1 the input is wrong; 4 a lock is held; retry later; 5 the ledger is written but not committed; re-run the same --close
- `orca control get`: 0 the panel answered 2xx; 1 refused here; 2 the panel answered an error
- `orca control send`: 0 the panel answered 2xx; 1 refused here; 2 the panel answered an error

## Global flags

- `--json`: print exactly one JSON line: {schema,status,commandId?,body,request?}
- `--project <project>`: the project (id or path); default: the registered repository holding cwd
- `--control-state-dir <control-state-dir>`: the panel's control state directory (its socket lives there)
- `--quiet`: print nothing on success
- `--verbose`: print more
- `--help`: this command's help
- `--command-id <command-id>`: use this id for a new request (a write)
- `--if-revision <n>`: send this revision instead of the one just read (a write)
- `--as-person`: send the person token stored by orca login
